Ieyasu had said that she should raise the child Yoshikatsu had left behind with care, while bearing more fine children, for that was a woman’s calling… In his words she felt love and warmth.

units.source_en: O-Ai was gentle without but strong within, yet for all her inner fierceness she felt no anger.
units.source_zh: 阿爱是一个外柔内刚的女人，但内心刚烈的她却并不感到愤怒。

units.source_zh: 家康说，要好好抚养义胜遗下的孩子，同时生育更多更好的儿女，那才是女人的使命……她从家康的话中感受到了爱和温暖。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, O-Ai returned with her uncle, Saigō Saemon-no-suke Kiyokazu.

units.source_en: Before long, O-Ai returned with her uncle, Saigō Saemon-no-suke Kiyokazu.
units.source_zh: 未几，阿爱就和她的叔父西乡左卫门佐清员一起过来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 未几，阿爱就和她的叔父西乡左卫门佐清员一起过来。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, did you summon me?”

units.source_en: “My lord, did you summon me?”
units.source_zh: “主公，您叫我？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公，您叫我？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Kiyokazu, take O-Ai as your adopted daughter.”

units.source_en: “Kiyokazu, take O-Ai as your adopted daughter.”
units.source_zh: “清员，将阿爱收为你的养女。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “清员，将阿爱收为你的养女。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What did you say, my lord?”

units.source_en: “What did you say, my lord?”
units.source_zh: “主公说什么？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公说什么？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Take O-Ai as your daughter and keep her in your household for the time being. Take her home at once!”

units.source_en: “Take O-Ai as your daughter and keep her in your household for the time being.
units.source_zh: “将阿爱收为你的女儿，暂时寄在你处。

units.source_en: Take her home at once!”
units.source_zh: 快带回家去吧！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “将阿爱收为你的女儿，暂时寄在你处。快带回家去吧！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah… has O-Ai done something wrong?”

units.source_en: “Ah… has O-Ai done something wrong?”

ja.t: したのでございますか」

units.source_zh: “啊……阿爱做错什么了吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊……阿爱做错什么了吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. It would be wrong to let her continue serving others here. Keep her at home until I tell you to bring her out. Treat her well.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
It would be wrong to let her continue serving others here.

paragraphs.source_en: Kiyokazu still seemed unable to understand and lowered his head in thought. Her face crimson, O-Ai knelt behind her uncle.
